name: TeamPermissions
title: Templates/Platform/Account/TeamPermissions
summary: Teams and their permissions. The primary is the Teams and permissions list: a `PageHeader` with Create Team, search and Refresh over a `Table` of teams (name as `Table.CellLink` with a square `Avatar` and the description, permissions as `Table.CellTags` with `+N`, members, `Table.CellStatus`, and `Table.CellActions` with Edit, Duplicate and Delete behind a `ConfirmDialog`), on one `useCollection`. The CreateTeam variant is the permission matrix: General (name, description), a Permissions table grouped by area with View and Edit columns, a group `Checkbox` that is indeterminate when partly checked, filter, Select all and Clear, Edit implying View, and a `SaveBar`.

variants.name: CreateTeam
variants.summary: The Create Team page: name and description, the View and Edit permission matrix grouped by area with group checkboxes, filter, Select all and Clear, a status Switch, and Save in a SaveBar; errors on the name field and above the matrix.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No team yet: the heading and a flush EmptyState with Create Team replace the search row and the table.
